description: Sentiment bucket (bullish, bearish, neutral or mixed) for an entity over 1d, 7d, 30d or 90d, rolled up hourly from the news BCA ingests and BCA's own articles: mention counts, mean score and the top bullish and bearish articles (drivers). Unseeded when no article mentions the entity in the window, stale when its newest window closed hours ago. Works without an API key.
name: get_sentiment
